skills.name: Abyss Walker
skills.description: Moskov teleports to the target location, increasing his Attack Speed to 1.15 times for 3s. Meanwhile, his Basic Attack deals 10% more damage to enemies behind the primary target.
skills.tips: when using this on Initiating an attack constalnly use this to reposition yourself, since its very vital for moskov to change his angle for better damage output by taking advantage his passive and on his other abilities, this will give you higher survivability specially on team clash where he needs to be at the back and give him a good space to launch his attacks.

skills.name: Spear of Misery
skills.description:
Moskov launches a powerful strike at the target enemy hero or Creep, dealing 300<font color='#D58E1F'>( +60% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font>, knocking them back, and revealing their position for 5s.
If the target collides with an enemy hero when knocked back, they'll both take 200<font color='#D58E1F'>( +30% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> and be stunned for 1.5s. If the enemy is knocked into a wall, they will also be stunned for the same duration.
skills.tips: You can also use this skill to push enemy away from to their tower, just use your first skill to teleport at the back on your enemy and then use your second skill to push him away from the tower,  just be aware that this act is very dangerous since you will get closer to the tower.

skills.name: Spear of Destruction
skills.description:
After a short delay, Moskov throws the <font color='#404495'>(Spear of Destruction)</font> in the target direction, dealing 340<font color='#D58E1F'>( +100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies in its path and to the first enemy hero hit. Upon hitting an enemy hero, the spear pierces them, dealing 10% extra <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies behind them. The target and enemies hit by the piercing damage will be slowed by 50% for 1s (the slow duration scales with the spear's travel time, up to 3s).
When <font color='#404495'>(Spear of Destruction)</font> hits the first enemy hero, it creates a shadow behind them and refreshes the cooldown of <font color='#404495'>(Abyss Walker)</font>.
<font color='#404495'>(Use Again)</font>: Moskov casts <font color='#404495'>(Abyss Walker)</font> from the shadow's location (shares the same cooldown as the skill).
skills.tips: Keep an eye on the minimap and check if there's a clash just be aware if there is an enemy with a low health you can easily finish him off by using this ability, you can use this by mannual targeting you will see an indicator or marking which you will see it on the minimap this will greatly help you to estimate and use this ability.

skills.name: Spear of Quiescence
skills.description: Moskov's Basic Attacks can penetrate the target and deal <font color='#D58E1F'>( +68% Total Physical Attack)</font>-<font color='#D58E1F'>( +110% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color='#C53535'>(Physical Damage)</font> to enemies behind them (inherits Attack Effects). Each Basic Attack hit reduces the cooldowns of <font color='#404495'>(Abyss Walker)</font> and <font color='#404495'>(Spear of Misery)</font> by 0.8s.
skills.tips: On a team clash always keep an eye where enemy heroes will be closer to each other or they align on a perpendicular manner, this will give more advantage for you since you can take hits on them and share the damage.

items.name: Windtalker
items.des: Unique Passive - Typhoon: Every 5-2s (reduced by 0.2s for each Basic Attack), the next Basic Attack will hit up to 3 enemy units for 150-362 Magic Damage. (This attack can Crit and the damage increases to 200% against Minions.)

items.name: Berserker's Fury
items.des: Unique Passive - Doom: Critical strikes grant 5% extra Physical Attack for 2s.

items.name: Haas' Claws
items.des: Unique Passive - Frenzy: Critical strikes grant 20% Attack Speed for 2s.

items.name: Great Dragon Spear
items.des: Unique Passive - Supreme Warrior: After casting an Ultimate, increase Movement Speed by 15% for 7.5s. This effect has a 15s cooldown.

items.name: Malefic Roar
items.des: Unique Passive - Armor Buster: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.125% extra Physical Penetration for each point of the enemy's Physical Defense, capped at 40%.

builds.tips: This builds will be interchanged it depends on any scenarios, I choose the Build 1 since moskov have already a good amount of attack speed we will more focus now on damaging  and debuff items.
